dossier_requests.what: Root cause of the zero-cell bug: its successor list names the older collective sumerian-city-states (-3400), so compile_dossiers.py R2 makes the collective beat Ur's city for Ur's whole life. Either also list first-dynasty-of-ur among sumerian-city-states' successors (when each lists the other, R2 picks the later-born, Ur), or drop the successor entry, since the -2340 handover is already booked by Ur's dissolve and the collective's gain. A compiler alternative: apply R2 only from the predecessor's end year. With either fix events/0 and keyframe_overrides/0 become unnecessary and can be withdrawn.
dossier_requests.why: The dynasty 'reigned c. 2600 - c. 2340 BC' from Ur and Mesannepada's hegemony is 'r. c. 2500 BC'; the same pattern appears for umma (m2500-m2401 events/0 works around it).

problems: CROSS-WINDOW: keyframe_overrides/0 (sumerian-city-states, shape_id sumerian-city-states_-2500) is in m2600-m2501.json but acts from -2500, in window m2500-m2401. m2500-m2401.json does not override that keyframe (its overrides are first-dynasty-of-ur_-2500 and lagash_-2450), so there is no double override and mine is first in window order; the m2500-m2401 agent should be told and must not add a competing override for sumerian-city-states_-2500. It keeps the dossier's own correction (cliopatria -2500 minus Mari 120 km minus Khuzestan) and adds only Ur 40 km to the cut. If the orchestrator does not want it, withdraw events/0 and keyframe_overrides/0 together: events/0 alone harms -2500..-2340.

events/0 leaves one harmless conflict in the -2600 trial: first-dynasty-of-ur / sumerian-city-states, 21 cell-years in 1 year (R2; the found event's 19 cells plus the keyframe's 2 overlap cells), which the gain of 17 cells settles in the same year; before the patch it was 38 cell-years.

Ur's 40 km radius is the dossier's own choice (its keyframe note says so), not a sourced figure; its 19-cell circle overlaps lagash's 40 km circle by 2 cells, cut from Ur so that Lagash's -2520 founding keeps its 19 cells.

compiler: cells a patch hands over before a year are no longer event-settled when the same land is regained by event in that year, so a later keyframe of an R2 'successor' can take them back; this is why the cross-window override is needed (see dossier_requests).
